coat.label: Coat
coat.describe: Warm taupe hide across the back, rear neck and skull.

flank.label: Flank
flank.describe: Warm ochre flanks and column limbs.

belly.label: Belly
belly.describe: Cream throat, chest and belly skin.

mottle.label: Mottle
mottle.describe: Restrained umber skin pigment on the back and rear neck.

size.label: Size
size.describe: Herd size from small to large, rebuilding the complete animal and its bind skeleton in metres.

neck.label: Neck carriage
neck.describe: A continuous eight-joint curve, from forward grazing with the head near four metres to an upright twelve-metre silhouette at adult size.

head.label: Head size
head.describe: Compact crested skull, muzzle and face scaled together at the upper neck.

tail.label: Tail length
tail.describe: Tapered tail length, retaining its full pelvis root and six-joint articulation.

colorway.label: Colorway
colorway.describe: Kit-coherent hide palettes: dusty umber, warm ochre, or river grey. Explicit colour values override the selected palette.

materials_note: what each colour zone is made of: `kind` and `finish` name a procedural PBR material in https://polyfork.dev/materials.mjs (dressByAlbedo finds a zone by its albedo in COLOR_0). A zone not listed has not been classified.
